close_reason: STARTTLS implemented on inbound SMTP ports 25/587. RFC 3207 compliant: advertises STARTTLS in EHLO when TLS is configured, upgrades session on STARTTLS command, guards AUTH with 530 before TLS is established. Tests: test_ehlo_includes_starttls_when_tls_acceptor_present, test_auth_before_starttls_returns_530. Committed in c3cc3cd..360fc53.
description: crates/smtp/src/session.rs currently returns '454 TLS not available' for the STARTTLS command. This is a stub. STARTTLS must be implemented for: (1) REQUIRETLS (RFC 8689) — REQUIRETLS EHLO keyword only appears after TLS is established; (2) auth-before-STARTTLS guard (stoa-ovjps) — reject AUTH on plaintext sessions; (3) RFC 3207 compliance. Implementation: load TLS config (cert, key) from SmtpConfig, upgrade the TCP stream to TLS using tokio-rustls on STARTTLS command, set is_tls=true, re-advertise EHLO capabilities (now including REQUIRETLS). Reject STARTTLS if already TLS.
title: Implement STARTTLS on inbound SMTP (port 587/25)
